historical_source: OpenClaw Slime task-reward normalization before an exclusion guard was introduced
helper_adaptation: Use the local Fragment type for the type-only annotation. The grouping, reward selection, centering, sample-standard-deviation and expansion functions are unchanged.
callback_adaptation: Use the historical task-side call sequence in a PyTorch training loop with a local ticket catalog. Terminal timeouts carry the same zero reward and exclusion semantics. The reconstruction omits the historical cost budget.
data: Synthetic ticket splits generated by environment_tool.py with independent seeds.
recorded_evidence: Metrics and three synthetic rollout snapshots copied byte for byte from the observed training arm. The published snapshot omits checkpoint tensors and platform stdout. The remaining source is identical to the run apart from the type-only import above.
